|descr= Register code to be executed after mission end.
{{Feature|arma3|

}}

|s1= argument call [[BIS_fnc_onEnd]]

|p1= argument: [[Code]], [[Array]] or [[Number]]:
* [[Code]] - code to be executed
* [[Array]] - code with arguments in format [code, arguments]
* [[Number]] - remove code at given index

|r1= [[Number]] - index of onEnd code

|x1= <sqf>private _onEndIndex = { player addRating 10000; } call BIS_fnc_onEnd;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _onEndIndex = [{ { _x addRating 10000; } forEach _this; }, units group player] call BIS_fnc_onEnd;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Event Scripts]] [[Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers#Ended|Ended Mission Event Handler]]
